summary: Santacruz Silver Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 9, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the publication of its 2025 Sustainability Report for its Mexican subsidiary, Compañía Minera Zilar Mendi (formerly Carrizal Mining). The filing discloses environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance metrics such as electricity consumption of 696.31 kWh per tonne of concentrate and a 27.62% reduction in non-mineral hazardous waste. There are no special-situation elements: no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a routine disclosure of non-financial information without any deal terms or corporate event. No action required.
